我的生活与自然(My Life and nature): 一篇关于自然环境的A2短文:汤姆与安娜的经历和小计划。

Tom is going to travel to London in September. The plant garden is one of the best places in the city. Tom thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. In fact, try to reduce food waste at home.
Tom wants to be a engineer in the future. Last Saturday, Tom and Anna went to the plant garden. There are always many people at the green hill. A short shower passed over the village.
Life is full of small surprises. Tom bought a sweater at the shop yesterday. The weather was windy that day. Also, add a little salt to the soup.
Tom and Anna had great fun there. Tom hopes to visit London one day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the plant garden by bike.
